textbookText: 32. A projectile is fired with a velocity of 320 ms-1 at an angle of 300 with the horizontal. Find (i) the time to reach the greatest height, (ii) its horizontal range and (iii) with the same velocity, what is the maximum possible range? (16 s, 8868 m, 10240 m)

33. A ball is allowed to fall down from a height of 60 m and at the same time another similar ball is thrown vertically up with an initial velocity of 20 ms-1 along the same vertical line. Find when and where they will meet. ( take g = 10 ms-2). ( Ans; After 3 s at 15 m above the ground)
34. A body begins its motion to move and attains a velocity of 25 ms-1 in 5 s and 34 ms-1 in 8 s. Calculate the distance it travelled in the 12th second. (Ans: 34.5 m)
35. Suppose an object is thrown with initial speed 10 m s-1 at an angle π/4 with the horizontal, what is the range covered? Suppose the same object is thrown similarly in Physics, Grade 11 | 71
the Moon, will there be any change in the range? If yes, what is the change? (The acceleration due to gravity in the Moon = 1/6 g)

(Ans: RE = 10m, RM = 60 m) 36. In a game of cricket, a batsman strikes the ball in such a way that it moves with the speed of 30 m s-1 at an angle 30o with the horizontal. The boundary line of the cricket ground is located at a distance of 75 m from the batsman. Will the ball go for a six? (Neglect the air resistance and take acceleration due to gravity g = 10 m s-2). (Ans: R = 77.94 m which is greater than 75 m and hence the ball goes for six.)

37. An athlete executing a long jump leaves the ground at 270 and lands at a point 7.80 m away. (a) What was the take-off speed? (b) If the speed is increased by 5%, how much longer would the jump be? (Ans: a. 10.72 ms-1, b. 8.6 m )
38. A long jumper leaves the ground at 200 above the horizontal at a speed of 11 ms-1. How far does he jump in the horizontal direction? What is the maximum height attained? (Ans: 7.86 m, 0.72 m)

39. A football player kicks the ball from the ground level at 27 ms-1 at an angle 300 above the horizontal. Neglecting the air resistance, find; a. the ball’s hang time, b. the ball’s maximum height, and c. the horizontal distance the ball travels before hitting the ground. (Ans: a. 2.8 s, b.

9.3 m, c. 65 m) 40. A rock is thrown from a 50.0-m high cliff with an initial velocity of 7.0 ms-1 at an angle of 53.0° above the horizontal. Find its velocity when it hits the ground below. (Ans: 32 ms-1, 820 from horizontal.)
